name: bug-triage-fix
description: Bug intake → QA reproduces → branch on the outcome. If reproduced: check the tracker — fix straight away when a ticket already exists, else open one first, then run the fix subflow. If NOT reproducible: capture findings and report back. Showcases nested `switch` (deterministic value branching) composed with a `subflow` for the fix.

phases.name: reproduce
assess
find-ticket
create-ticket

default.name: capture-findings
